items.summary:
Mary Cosby is alleging that Real Housewives of Salt Lake City viewers don’t necessarily have the full picture of what led up to her explosive season 7 confrontation with Angie Katsanevas .

“By the time we were filming, I was already built up [with anger],” Mary, 54, told Andy Cohen on the Wednesday, November 18, episode of Watch What Happens Live With Andy Cohen . “She kept doing things and kept dismissing it.”

The longtime friends had a shocking falling out earlier in the season when Angie, 53, argued with Mary over whether or not she was prioritizing her marriage to husband Shawn Trujillo . (Angie and Shawn separated over the summer after nearly 30 years of marriage.)

“All you care about is yourself. What happened to your husband? What happened to your child?” Mary asked during the heated argument, with Angie shooting back, “What happened to your husband? What happened to your child? What are you talking about?”

Bravo Stars React to Mary Cosby’s Son Robert Cosby Jr.’s Death 

Angie’s comments stunned her RHOSLC castmates as the scene was shot mere weeks after Mary’s only son, Robert Cosby Jr. , died at age 23 of a suspected overdose.

Looking back on her rift with Angie, Mary maintained that their issues arose when she told her RHOSLC castmate about Robert Jr.’s death.

“[Viewers] see a version of what happened and that did happen. Also, building up to it, the reason I think I was so forceful was because, in the beginning when it first happened, I called her first,” Mary recalled. “The first thing [Angie] said was, ‘I knew it! I knew it!’ I said, ‘Don’t talk like…

items.title: NFL Alums Rob Gronkowski and Julian Edelman Slam Sam Hartman Over 'Bachelor'
items.summary:
NFL alums Rob Gronkowski and Julian Edelman may not be tuning in when Washington Commanders practice squad quarterback Sam Hartman makes his debut as the next Bachelor .

“We’re promoting [ The Bachelor ] in the middle of a season? What are we doing?” Edelman, 40, complained on the Monday, November 16, episode of the “Gronk & Jules Show” podcast. “He better be getting like a mill! He better be getting a lot of money.”

The retired football stars and their producer Jack McCarthy were all in agreement that the timing was wrong for ABC’s Friday, November 13, announcement confirming Hartman, 27, as the next star of the hit reality dating show.

Thoughts and half-price prayers with Poundland, please. The discount chain has been on the verge of collapse for a while, and its future looks bleak. Now, to add to the ignominy, David Beckham is kicking it while it’s down.

Not literally, by the way: I suppose I should spell that out since we’re dealing with a litigious billionaire. I did not mean to imply or cause a reasonable person to infer that Sir David is standing on Brixton high street kicking a Poundland. Rather, DB Ventures, the licensor of the David Beckham brand, is causing a bit of a stink about the fact that the football legend’s fragrance range was found on sale in the discount store as well as at other purveyors of budget goods. It is now suing the perfume company, Coty, which it further accuses of under reporting sales, for $41m (£31m).
